current.text: The Spurs started Harper, Fox and Castle together in the preseason. The latest projected starters are Fox, Harper, Castle, Vassell and Wembanyama.
He is expected to start for the first time in his career.

Most experts expect about 29 to 30 minutes a night. Dan takes the under on 28.5 minutes. It is also unclear whether all three starting guards get starter minutes, and the deep roster may keep minutes low after the long playoff run.
His strong second half came from hot shooting that experts expect to regress.
Worth drafting in the 80s, with upside to the top 60 but a rough floor. Josh took him at 73 for assists and would take him over Stephon Castle in any standard league.
Upside case: 25 percent usage, about 18 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists, 1.3 steals and elite percentages.
He could become the Spurs' second-best player by the end of the season and take on-ball time from Fox and Castle.
The Spurs are projected to be a top team in the West, with one prediction of 63 wins.
The Spurs play 3, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21 and have only 13 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is not a big rebounder, not a high-volume three-point shooter and not a very high-usage player.
The Spurs see him as a future superstar and part of their long-term backcourt with Castle.
He is a much better defender than people think.
Balanced category profile with no weak category. His FG% is well above other guards, and assists are his best category against the pool.

note: Both sites put his average cost near 5 USD (Yahoo rank 85, ESPN 99). Experts now take him in the 70s and 80s, so a price of 5 to 10 USD fits the "draft in the 80s, upside to top 60" call. He has no weak category and fits any build, with assists and FG% as his main help. Early in the season, check that he stays in the starting lineup and plays 29 or more minutes, and watch whether his roughly 50% FG% holds or falls back.
